leads.name: The Woodford Tree
leads.reason: National Trusts of Australia significant tree register (https://trusttrees.org.au/tree/NSW/Woodford/Blue_Mountains_National_Park_MurphyS_Fire_Track): 71 m tall, 2 m diameter, measured 20 June 2013, classified 25 June 2013, good condition, access unrestricted, 'tallest of its species in NSW'. Location is only 'Blue Mountains National Park, Murphy's Fire Track, Woodford', no coordinate, no NPWS source, no alive evidence after 2013, no photo. Single source with no pin: lead. Fire trail may have closures (NPWS local alerts).
